summary: Deterministic filler/dupe detect, scoped FM refill
hypothesis: Freeing wasted slots (filler phrases and near-duplicate questions) and refilling only those with a scoped model call should recover coverage, because the 3B already knows task-specific unknowns but wastes slots on redundant or vague catch-alls.
technique: On top of the exp011 contrastive-RAG draft, deterministic Swift detects wasted slots via curated filler-phrase patterns and Jaccard near-dupe pairs, then a single scoped FM call refills only those slots (shown the kept questions, given no universal checklist). Strong slots are kept verbatim and a defensive re-check reverts any refills that are themselves filler or dupes.

stages.text: Draft 7 questions via exp011 contrastive-RAG prompt
Swift detects filler phrases + Jaccard near-dupes
Scoped refill call for wasted slots only
Defensive re-check; revert refills that are filler/dupes
